source: David Tom Foss Hugging Face CPU-basic actual end-to-end model experiment, 2026-11-06
activation_arithmetic: fixed per-coordinate ternary activation codes calibrated on a real greedy trace
conclusion: The temporal state algebra reproduces the full quantized model's entire greedy token sequence, but one Python/PyTorch event wrapper per Linear module is 2.01x slower on this 64-wide model. The remaining bottleneck is dispatch and graph fragmentation, so the production route must fuse event detection, atomic/macro response caches and all consumers of a state into one codec-native block executor.
